case_title: Tired, racing heart, foggy, and an upset stomach
case_summary_for_demo: 42-year-old woman seen by family medicine, cardiology and gastroenterology for fatigue, palpitations, brain fog and digestive symptoms. Each specialist sees one piece.
main_concern: I've been exhausted for six months and my heart races when I climb stairs. I can't concentrate at work. My stomach has been bloated and sore. Each doctor looked at one thing and said it was probably fine.

symptoms.details: Need a nap after work; worse in the afternoon.
Mostly on stairs or walking fast. Sometimes lightheaded when I stand up.
Losing my train of thought in meetings.
Burning feeling after meals, better with food some days.
Most days; I take ibuprofen almost every day.
Periods are heavier than they used to be.

medications.name: Propranolol
medications.how_often: up to twice a day when my heart races

lifestyle.exercise: used to run; stopped because of fatigue

questions_for_panel: Are my heart racing, tiredness and stomach problems connected?
Should I still be taking ibuprofen?
